title: Cost Model service skeleton + API endpoints (authz, validation, deterministic pipeline)
creator: Ethan Park
description:
## Context
We need a platform-owned Cost Model service that Console + Optimize can call to get deterministic cost estimates and (later) explain/attribution outputs. This ticket covers standing up the service skeleton and the first set of API endpoints with:
- authn/authz + RBAC gating for customer cost views
- request validation against SCM v1 schema
- deterministic calculation pipeline (initially simple; no pricing/discount logic)
- feature-flagged routing so we can canary by tenant/tier

This work is explicitly NOT changing billing/invoicing; outputs are for Console/Optimize transparency + recommendations only.

## Goals (this ticket)
1) Service skeleton deployed in all regions (hosted + dedicated control planes) behind feature flag.
2) Implement endpoint plumbing + standardized error model.
3) Add request validation and stable, deterministic compute path (same inputs => same outputs).
4) Wire minimal dependencies (model catalog resolver for GPU SKU + quant profile metadata; telemetry optional at this stage).

## Non-goals
- Customer-facing pricing engine (contract terms/discounts)
- Full metered attribution (requires telemetry pipeline changes)
- Optimize multi-scenario sweep endpoint (separate ticket)

## Proposed API surface (v1)
- POST /cost-model/estimate
  - Input: SCM v1 request payload (see ENG-23114 / schema PR)
  - Output: total_cost + breakdown + assumptions + confidence
- POST /cost-model/explain (stub in this ticket; full payload in follow-up)
  - For now: return same breakdown plus limited contributing factors when available

Version negotiation is implemented in ENG-23203; this ticket should expose the header/payload hooks but can default to v1.

## Authn/Authz
- Authn: internal service auth via gateway-issued JWT (standard platform service-to-service)
- Authz:
  - Console/Optimize service principals: allowed
  - Internal tooling: allowed behind allowlist
  - Any customer-initiated requests must come through Console/Hosted API with tenant context; no direct public exposure
- RBAC checks:
  - require tenant_id + environment (hosted/dedicated/private) in request context
  - deny requests without tenant context unless internal debug mode (staging only)
- Audit events: emit COST_MODEL_ESTIMATE_READ + COST_MODEL_EXPLAIN_READ (field list per security spec; implemented in follow-up security ticket but add hook points here)

## Request validation
- Strict JSON/proto validation against SCM v1 types
- Required fields: model_id OR resolved_model_ref, region, gpu_sku (or resolvable), token counts for prompt/completion OR prefill/decode tokens depending on mode
- Validation behavior:
  - Missing required => 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT
  - Unsupported version => 400 UNSUPPORTED_VERSION (see ENG-23203)
  - Unknown model_id => 404 MODEL_NOT_FOUND (after catalog lookup)
  - Unknown/unsupported gpu_sku => 400 UNSUPPORTED_GPU_SKU
- Important: validation errors must be stable (same input -> same error codes/messages) to avoid client flakiness.

## Deterministic calculation pipeline (v0)
- Pure function calculation core (library module) invoked by handler
- Inputs normalized before calculation (e.g., token units, time units)
- No external lookups after normalization step except read-only catalog metadata (pinned by version)
- Output must include:
  - currency: USD (for internal cost units) or "compute_units" if not convertible; for v1 we standardize to USD with explicit assumptions
  - breakdown components at least: compute_cost, memory_cost, overhead_cost (overhead can be 0 initially)
  - assumptions: list of explicit assumptions used when signals are missing
  - confidence_score: 0.0-1.0

## Implementation notes
- Service name: cost-model-service
- Ownership: Eng Platform / Control Plane
- Runtime:
  - Go service (consistent with other platform services)
  - Shared SCM types imported from redwood/common (see schema PR)
- Caching:
  - Request-level memoization only (per-request), no cross-tenant shared cache in v0
  - Explicitly avoid caching based solely on model_id due to version/region/SKU differences
- Observability:
  - Structured logs include: request_id, tenant_id (hashed), model_id, region, gpu_sku, version
  - Metrics: request count, validation failures by code, p95 latency, upstream catalog latency

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] Service compiles and deploys to staging, reachable behind gateway route
- [x] POST /estimate returns deterministic output for fixed inputs (snapshot tests)
- [x] Authz enforced: missing tenant context is rejected in prod; allowed only in staging debug mode
- [x] Validation errors follow agreed error model and are documented in README
- [x] Unit tests for validation + calculation core (golden fixtures)
- [x] Integration test in staging: Console can call /estimate with feature flag on (smoke)
- [x] Feature flag supports tenant allowlist (Benji to help wire config)

## Rollout plan (this ticket)
1) Staging: enable for internal tenants only
2) Prod canary: allowlist 1-2 internal tenants + one low-risk external tenant (with PM approval)
3) Gradually expand once SLO dashboards are in place (separate ticket)

## Links / references
- Engineering spec / schema: ENG-23114; Confluence "standard-cost-model-spec-v1"
- API conventions: Confluence "cost-model-api-conventions"
- Related PRs:
  - https://github.com/redwood/redwood/pull/18436 (service skeleton + routing + auth plumbing)
  - https://github.com/redwood/redwood/pull/18452 (deterministic calculation engine initial components)
  - https://github.com/redwood/redwood/pull/18469 (model-catalog integration for gpu sku + quant profile metadata)

## Follow-ups / out of scope
- ENG-23203: version negotiation + compatibility tests
- ENG-23231: security review + audit logging event fields finalized
- ENG-23217: dashboards/alerts + mismatch detectors
- ENG-23173: Console caching/fallback behavior (client-side)

## Notes / decisions captured during implementation
- We decided to keep the calculation core in a separate package used by handlers to guarantee determinism and allow reuse by internal tooling.
- We are not depending on telemetry pipeline for v0; if telemetry-derived fields are missing, we emit explicit assumptions and reduce confidence.
- We intentionally return 400 for "missing region" rather than defaulting, to avoid silent cross-region normalization errors (this caused earlier staging confusion; documented in client guidance).

2025-02-14 (Dr. Aisha Rahman): Treat tenant_id + per-route breakdown as customer-sensitive. Even if values are estimates, require audit hooks for reads and restrict logs (hash tenant_id, avoid raw prompts).

2025-02-19 (Marissa Cole): Console needs stable error semantics; if SCM is down, we will show "Estimated cost unavailable" and fall back to legacy aggregation. Please do not return 200 with partial zeros.

2025-03-05 (Amara Diallo): Merged skeleton + estimate endpoint behind flag. Explain endpoint remains stubbed (returns estimate response shape with explain_not_available assumption). Follow-up filed for full explain payload once schema lands.
